# Version 4.150.0
> **Modern filters and faster raster** · Released July 7, 2026 · [NuGet](https://www.nuget.org/packages/SkiaSharp/4.150.0) · [GitHub Release](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/releases/tag/v4.150.0)

> **API changes** · [SkiaSharp API diff](4.150.0/index.md) · [HarfBuzzSharp API diff](harfbuzzsharp/14.2.1/index.md)

## Highlights

SkiaSharp 4.150.0 brings Skia m150, composable image filters, and faster CPU blurs. New overdraw and paint-bounds helpers support rendering diagnostics and culling. Upgraders should replace remaining pre-v4 obsolete APIs and account for the removed notebook integration.

## Breaking Changes

- **Replace remaining pre-v4 obsolete APIs** — Legacy GRBackendRenderTarget constructors with sampleCount, run-buffer accessors, SKPaintHinting, and SKFilterQuality now produce compile errors. Use constructors without sampleCount, Glyphs/Positions properties, SKFontHinting, and SKSamplingOptions. The enums leave the reference assembly but remain in the implementation for ABI compatibility. The two SKFont-based DrawText overloads without explicit alignment remain warning-only. ([#4195](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4195))
- **Notebook integration is no longer bundled** — SkiaSharp no longer ships its .NET Interactive/Polyglot Notebooks extension after upstream deprecation. Notebook consumers must provide their own rendering integration rather than relying on automatic SkiaSharp formatters. ([#4186](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4186))

## Engine

- **Skia milestone m150** — Updates the bundled renderer from m148 to m150 while preserving Tizen PDF support and the existing Windows runtime floor. ([#4146](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4146))
- **Bundled HarfBuzz 14.2.1** — Includes upstream AAT and Arabic fallback shaping corrections, COLR v1 paint and clipping fixes, and more accurate glyph extents. ([#4167](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4167))

## API Surface

- **Composable crop and empty image filters** — SKImageFilter.CreateCrop restricts filter output with a rectangle and tile mode. CreateEmpty supplies a transparent-black node that discards its input. ([#4229](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4229), [#4228](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4228))
- **Overdraw visualization and conservative paint bounds** — SKColorFilter.CreateOverdraw maps draw counts to a six-color palette. SKPaint.GetFastBounds returns conservative bounds for quick-reject culling, or false when they cannot be computed. ([#4227](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4227), [#4271](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4271))

## Bug Fixes

- **Faster small-sigma CPU blurs** — Restores the dedicated raster blur path for small-sigma 8888 images, avoiding the slower shader-based Gaussian path. — ❤️ [@ramezgerges](https://github.com/ramezgerges) ([#4269](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4269))
- **Apple typeface stream synchronization** — Corrects a race between opening and reusing a CoreText-backed typeface stream on Apple platforms. ([#4190](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4190))

## Lifecycle & Internals

- **Lower-overhead surface canvas access** — SKSurface.Canvas reuses its managed wrapper instead of repeating native lookups on every access. Explicitly disposing that wrapper still allows a subsequent access to obtain a usable wrapper. — ❤️ [@ramezgerges](https://github.com/ramezgerges) ([#4247](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4247))

## HarfBuzzSharp 14.2.1

The collected HarfBuzzSharp-specific work migrates its test suite to xUnit v3; that change does not alter shaping behavior or the binding API.
